questions.question: Eight boys Ram, Sumit, Sunil, Rahul, Raj, Aman, Amit and Anil are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Anil is not the immediate neighbour of Raj or Rahul. Anil is to the immediate left of Ram. Amit is the immediate neighbour of Raj. Aman is to the immediate right of Sumit. 1) Aman is to the immediate right of Sumit and Sunil is sitting between Raj and Aman.

questions.question: Number of pens in five shops M1, M2, M3, M4 and M5 are compared. Number of pens in M3 are more than only M1. No two shops have same number of pens. Number of pens in M5 are less than M2 but more than M4. Number of pens in M5 are more than how many shops?
questions.solution:
Number of pens in five shops M1, M2, M3, M4 and M5 are compared.

1) Number of pens in M5 are less than M2 but more than M4.

M2 > M5 > M4

2) Number of pens in M3 are more than only M1.

M2 > M5 > M4 > M3 > M1

∴ Here, Number of pens in M5 are more than '3' shops.

Hence, the correct answer is **"3".**

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

6 = 9 ÷ 3 - 2 + 7
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : = and - 

Given equation is : 6 = 9 ÷ 3 - 2 + 7

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 6 - 9 ÷ 3 = 2 + 7

⇒ 6 - __**9 ÷ 3**__ = 2 + 7

⇒ 6 - 3 = __**2 + 7**__

⇒ __**6 - 3**__ = 9

⇒ 3 ≠ 9

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : **+ and =**

Given equation is : 6 = 9 ÷ 3 - 2 + 7

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 6 + 9 ÷ 3 - 2 = 7

⇒ 6 + __**9 ÷ 3**__ - 2 = 7

⇒ __**6 + 3**__ - 2 = 7

⇒ __**9 - 2**__ = 7

⇒ **7 = 7**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 3) : - and +

Given equation is : 6 = 9 ÷ 3 - 2 + 7

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 6 = 9 ÷ 3 + 2 - 7

⇒ 6 = __**9 ÷ 3**__ + 2 - 7

⇒ 6 = __**3 + 2**__ - 7

⇒ 6 = __**5 - 7**__

⇒ 6 ≠ - 2

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : + and ÷ 

Given equation is : 6 = 9 ÷ 3 - 2 + 7

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 6 = 9 + 3 - 2 ÷ 7

⇒ 6 = 9 + 3 - __**2 ÷ 7**__

⇒ 6 = __**9 + 3**__ - 0.285

⇒ 6 = __**12 - 0.285**__

⇒ 6 ≠ - 11.714

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"+ and =".**

questions.question:
After interchanging which two signs and two numbers, the value of the given equation will be '6'?

7 - 2 × 1 ÷ 3 + 5
questions.solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e5eadb7fb717e58fc4d0289a0ba8a184fd97b6cf1ef93972c2170c66d3e1984.png] 

**Given:**

7 - 2 × 1 ÷ 3 + 5

Interchanging two signs and two numbers as per the given options:

**1. + and -, 7 and 5**

⇒ 7 - 2 × 1 ÷ 3 + 5

After interchanging:

 ⇒ 5 + 2 × __**1 ÷ 3 **__- 7

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 5 + __**2 × 0.33**__ - 7

⇒ __**5 + 0.66**__ - 7

⇒ 5.66 - 7 = (-1.34)

**2. × and -, 5 and 3**

⇒ 7 - 2 × 1 ÷ 3 + 5

After interchanging:

⇒ 7 × 2 - __**1 ÷ 5**__ + 3

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**7 × 2**__ - 0.2 + 3

⇒ 14 - 0.2 + 3 = 16.8

**3. × and ÷, 2 and 7**

⇒ 7 - 2 × 1 ÷ 3 + 5

After interchanging:

⇒ 2 - __**7 ÷ 1**__ × 3 + 5

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 2 - __**7 × 3**__ + 5

⇒ 2 - 21 + 5 = (-14)

**4. × and ÷, 7 and 5**

⇒ 7 - 2 × 1 ÷ 3 + 5

After interchanging:

⇒ 5 -__** 2 ÷ 1**__ × 3 + 7

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 5 - __**2 × 3**__ + 7

⇒ 5 - 6 + 7

⇒ 12 - 6 =** 6**

Here, the value of the equation is **6.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".

questions.question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

36, 33, 39, 36, 42, 39, 45, ?
questions.solution:
**Logic : **Alternately (3) is subtracted and then (6) is added to each number subsequently.

So,

36 - 3 = 33

33 + 6 = 39

39 - 3 = 36

36 + 6 = 42

42 - 3 = 39

39 + 6 = 45

45 - 3 = **42**

Hence, **"42"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All diaries are books.

Some bags are diaries.

**Conclusions:**

I. All bags are books.

II. Some books are bags.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3208d26317f359ce87acc9cec956e8f209b36377a49fa5323f57b7c19fd6b8cb.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All bags are books → **Does not** Follow (As all diaries are books and some bags are diaries. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. Some books are bags → Follow (As all diaries are books and some bags are diaries. So, as some part of bags is common with diaries which whole comes in books therefore it is definitely true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows.**".
